name: Azayomi Tsuzuri
source:
Forgotten asocial type.
Reason for wanting to die: To at least make the choice by himself at the end.
Lingering attachment to this world: To leave a scar.

A mysterious boy with an out-of-this-world appearance like that of an angel. His morbid slenderness, speech pattern and constantly changing facial expressions make it impossible for anyone to know who he is or where he comes from. Despite his strange appearance, he’s quite innocent and boyish. He also wishes to commit suicide as a human being, but frequently refers to himself as ‘non-human’.

He describes himself as an angel or a demon, but it is unclear whether he’s telling the truth or not. It also appears that he esteems conceptual beauty. Stubborn, never bending his sense of values, regardless of public opinion.

[Translated from [url=http://clubsuicide.net]the official website[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/_MORPATH?s=20&t=j3Xffhv5h-Yo19sJry3tvA]Twitter[/url].]
